product_metadata.title: Great Bay Home 100% Turkish Cotton King Holiday Flannel Sheet Set | Deep Pocket, Soft Christmas Sheets | Warm, Double Brushed Bed Sheets | Anti-Pill Flannel Sheets (King, Holiday Words)
features: 100% Turkish Cotton Flannel Sheets: Made from high quality Turkish cotton, this extra soft flannel sheet set is durable and features a deep pocket to allow for easy bed making. These holiday lodge style flannel sheets are warm and cozy enough for fall and winter. They are easy to wash and are made pre-shrunk to avoid any further shrinking. With multiple solid color and pattern options, these flannel sheets would make the perfect fall, winter, and Christmas sheets for your home and camp.

Stylish and Cozy: Our flannel sheets deep pocket sets are double brushed for softness. We offer plenty of color and print options, even floral bed sheets. Stay warm and toasty on the coldest nights of winter and sleep better than ever. At Great Bay Home, we even have a variety of printed holiday sheets perfect for this holiday season. From Christmas to New Year's, these sheets are perfect!

Top Quality, Affordable Pricing: Our premium flannel bed sheets enhance the comfort level of any bed! These fall and winter sheets are extremely high-quality at an unbeatable value. You can feel the difference in our 170 GSM 100% Turkish Cotton Flannel. Stay cozy and comfy on the coldest nights of winter without overheating, and sleep better than ever in our extra soft flannel sheets!

Perfect Fit After Every Wash: The pocket size of these sheets is purposefully deep. It fits up to a 14" thick mattress for Full, Queen, King & California King and up to a 12" mattress for Twin & Twin XL. These fall sheets are easy to care for, as they are machine washable, wrinkle-resistant, fade-resistant, shrink resistant & pill-resistant. These flannel sheets with deep pockets are durable and long-lasting. What's included? Flannel fitted sheet, flannel top sheet, and flannel pillowcases!

Customer Focused: At Great Bay Home, customer satisfaction is of utmost importance to us. We are confident that you will love our products, but if you’re not satisfied with these flannel sheets, our customer service team will work with you to make it right. We have plenty of products available. Find your perfect bedding match in one of our collections. From floral sheets to winter plaid sheets, you are sure to find something perfect and cozy for your home!
